claims.statement: Between November 21 and 23, 2025, attackers compromised hundreds of npm packages and more than 25,000 GitHub repositories within a few hours.
Check Point counted 621 infected npm packages, 487 affected GitHub organizations and 14,206 leaked secrets, of which 2,485 remained valid.
Unit 42 described more than 25,000 malicious repositories across about 350 unique users.

unresolvedQuestions: Package counts differ by source (Check Point 621; other reports 640 to 800). Keep counts attributed, not merged.
Primary source needed: npm and GitHub advisories for the second wave.
Sales note: developer and CI credentials were the target; no customer impact should be inferred.
